q: Poincaré Recurrence Theorem says: for a measure-preserving transformation f of a finite measure space and a set A with μ(A)>0, almost every point of A:
exp: Poincaré recurrence: for finite measure systems, a.e. point of A returns to A infinitely often. The proof is simple: the sets A, f⁻¹A, f⁻²A,… cannot all be disjoint in a finite measure space.
